# Android Claude Code Skills

> 🤖 AI-Powered Android Development — Reusable skills for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor.
> Automate project analysis, code review, APK audit, translation sync, and Figma-to-Android code generation.

## Skills

- [Android Project Analyzer](skills/android-project-analyzer/SKILL.md): Analyze Android project architecture, dependencies, code quality, and potential issues. Generate comprehensive technical reports.
- [Android Translation Sync](skills/android-translation-sync/SKILL.md): Sync Android strings.xml translations from Excel spreadsheets across all language variants with automatic key generation.
- [Android Change Review](skills/android-change-review/SKILL.md): Review staged git changes or commits for Android crash risks, boundary conditions, lifecycle issues, and regressions.
- [APK Analyzer](skills/apk-analyzer/SKILL.md): Parse and audit Android APK files — extract metadata, classify permissions by risk, verify signatures, detect SDKs, produce security report.
- [Figma to Android](skills/figma-to-android/SKILL.md): Convert Figma design data (node JSON, layers, annotations, screenshots) to production-ready Android native XML + Kotlin code with 1:1 visual fidelity.

## Platform Integration

- **Claude Code**: `/plugin marketplace add aihip/android-claude-code-skills` → `/plugin install android-claude-code-skills@android-claude-code-skills`
- **OpenAI Codex**: Copy skills to `~/.agents/skills/` or `.agents/skills/` → Trigger with `$skill-name` or natural language
- **Gemini CLI**: Import via `@path/to/gemini-rules/*.md` in `GEMINI.md` or use slash commands (`/project-analyzer`, `/translation-sync`, `/change-review`, `/apk-analyzer`, `/figma-to-android`)
- **Cursor**: Copy `.mdc` files to `.cursor/rules/` for auto-activation on matching requests

## Quick Install

```bash
# Claude Code
/plugin marketplace add aihip/android-claude-code-skills
/plugin install android-claude-code-skills@android-claude-code-skills

# npm (global)
npm install -g android-claude-code-skills

# Codex/Cursor/Gemini CLI — see platform sections in README
```
